title: ENPAC 7006-BK 2-Drum Heavy-Duty Polyethylene Spill Pallet Replacement Grate (48" x 23") - Black
description: ENPAC 7006-BK is a black polyethylene spill pallet grate for 2-drum pallets. It is a removable support platform that sits above the sump of a spill containment pallet and supports containers above the sump with openings for liquid drainage. This grate is intended for hand truck transport applications and for indoor and outdoor applications. Key Features: Product type: Spill pallet grate for secondary spill containment systems. Capacity fit: Designed for use with 2-drum pallets. Material: Polyethylene construction. Dimensions: 48 in. L x 23 in. W x 1-3/4 in. H. Color: Black. Application: Used with hand truck transport setups. Compatibility: For use with ENPAC spill pallets, including Mfr. No. 5755-YE. Compatible with multiple ENPAC spill pallet models.
